thread:
maria: Quick thread : cohesive copy + routing plan for the upcoming launch. Focus areas: micro-heroes for social, landing hero variants (hosted/dedicated/private), webinar CTA language, and exact inbound routing. Keep social headlines <=9 words.

noah: I made 3 concise headline directions per mode: performance, cost, and control. Posting them now for rapid feedback.

tara: Also need matching CTAs that map cleanly to CRM workflows. Webinar clicks must pre-fill interest and tag lead as webinar_demo.

noah: Hosted headlines:
- "Launch LLM features with a managed API"
- "Fast inference, simple SDKs"
- "Lower inference costs as you scale"

noah: Dedicated headlines:
- "Reserved GPU capacity for production"
- "Predictable throughput, SLA-backed"
- "Scale reliably with dedicated serving"

noah: Private headlines:
- "Run inference inside your network"
- "On-prem & VPC deployments, enterprise-ready"
- "Full control: audit logs & keys"

maria: Love the sets. Tiny edits: remove the word 'managed' from Hosted A (sounds vendor-y), change to "hosted". Also please keep social copy free of raw latency numbers.

noah: Updated. Subcopy suggestions for landing pages (1 line each):
- Hosted: "Hosted API with streaming responses, SDKs, and transparent pricing."
- Dedicated: "Dedicated GPU pools, autoscaling, and SLA-backed latency targets."
- Private: "Customer-managed network, audit logs, and KMS/HSM integrations."

tara: CTA routing (exact hrefs/hidden tags for ops):
- Hosted CTA -> /signup?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=mini_launch&utm_variant=hosted
  hidden: campaign=mini_launch, source=social_card
- Dedicated CTA -> /sales/enterprise?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=mini_launch&utm_variant=dedicated
  hidden: campaign=mini_launch, source=social_card
- Private CTA -> /sales/private?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=mini_launch&utm_variant=private
  hidden: campaign=mini_launch, source=social_card
- Webinar CTA -> /demo?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=mini_launch&utm_medium=webinar_card
  hidden: campaign=mini_launch, source=webinar_card, tag=webinar_demo
Make sure CRM mapping: webinar_demo -> assign solutions.eng, trial_signup -> auto-activate trial, enterprise_lead -> AE_queue.

ops-bot: Playbook updated: https://drive.redwood/playbooks/mini-launch (edited by tara). Experiment entry created: id mini-hero-01 (start Fri 09:00 UTC, duration 14 days).

maria: Webinar CTA wording options: "See a live demo & cost snapshot" vs "See performance in action". Prefer the first for webinar promos (higher qual). Site demo button should be "See performance".

legal: Quick flag: Private page microcopy under CTA must include approved sentence: "Inputs remain with your infrastructure; Redwood does not store request content." We approved this morning (ref S-2033).

noah: Social post examples (short):
- Performance post: "Launch LLM features faster with Redwood. Join our demo to see benchmarks. #llm #inference"
- Cost post: "Reduce inference spend as you grow  Join our webinar for a simple cost comparison. #aicosts"

tara: Form tweaks: add checkbox on demo page: "Request cost estimate" which sets lead_type=pricing_request. Also add hidden field experiment=mini-hero-01 and variant=performance|cost.

maria: A/B plan: two creative buckets (performance-first vs cost-first). Social split 50/50, landing pages change hero + subcopy to match. Primary metrics: CTR -> demo page, demo->request cost, demo->trial conversion. Review after 72 hours.

ops-bot: UTM example for ops validation: /signup?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=mini_launch&utm_variant=performance.

noah: I'll add microcopy under CTAs: Hosted: "Try the hosted API (free trial)"; Dedicated: "Request capacity"; Private: "Contact sales: security packet available".

tara: Add micro-FAQ blurb under Dedicated: "Autoscale and burst options available  contact us for sizing."

maria: Next steps: Noah -> push copy variants to staging, Tara -> wire up hidden fields & CRM mapping, Ops-bot -> schedule experiment and notify #marketing. Check-in Thurs for pre-launch QA. :white_check_mark:
